title: CORE Parametric Template v1
description: Schema for a parametric template that defines a reusable command skeleton with typed variable slots. Templates produce command_candidates and MUST require command_validation=true. No live data, state events, or permissions may be cached.

template_id.description: Unique template identifier within its domain (e.g. 'synthetic_reports.daily_summary.v1').

template_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the canonical template structure (excluding variable values). Format: sha256:<64 lowercase hex chars>.

domain.description: Vocabulary domain this template belongs to (e.g. 'synthetic_reports').

type.description: Slot value type. 'enum' requires 'enum_values' to be non-empty.

required.description: Whether this slot must be bound before command compilation.

default.description: Optional default value when slot is not bound.

enum_values.description: Allowed values when type='enum'. Must be non-empty for enum slots.

slots.description: Variable slots that must be bound to produce a command_candidate.

action.description: Action identifier the compiled command will invoke (e.g. 'generate_report').

method.description: HTTP-like method semantics. 'write' and 'delete' require heightened safety review.

route.description: Target route the compiled command will execute.

requires_command_validation.description: Must be true. All parametric templates produce command_candidates and require downstream validation.

items.description: Categories that MUST NOT appear in any cache entry derived from this template.

forbidden_categories.description: Explicit prohibition of cacheable categories. Always includes at least 'live_results'.
